verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question for an AI app-building platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack documents no API keys or token issuance at all. Collaborator roles (bolt-docs-48) govern human access to projects, which is an adjacent control rather than agent API credentials. The OpenAPI probe found no public API (bolt-docs-2 probe returned 404 on all candidate paths).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
